product.name: Jayanth Trading Tiles System
product.objective: A dedicated trading-tiles module that lets a single tile trading business record inward purchases from suppliers, outward sales to dealers, physical stock adjustments, and view current stock position and sales reports — all organised by tile design and grade.
users: Data Entry Staff — records daily inward, sales, and adjustment entries
Stock Verifier — physically counts tiles at the warehouse and provides the count for adjustments
Management / Supervisor — views the stock dashboard and runs sales reports
core_features: Master data: Supplier, Staff, Dealer, Grade (9 grades), Trading Size-Design, Tile Design-Grade combination table
Trading Tiles Inward Form — grade rows auto-populated per selected design
Trading Tiles Sales Form — grade rows auto-populated per selected design
Trading Tiles Adjustment Form — physical vs software CB difference per grade
Stock Dashboard — Opening / Inward / Outward / Adjust / Closing per design-grade, filtered by date
Sales Report — Consolidation + Transaction views shown together with multi-select filters
Monthly stock carry-forward (closing balance of Month N → opening of Month N+1)
non_goals: User login and access control (Version 1 — all users share full access)
Inward Report (only Sales Report in this version)
Report export to PDF or Excel
success_criteria: Closing balance matches physical count after every adjustment entry
Only valid design-grade combinations appear on forms (RULE-005 / RULE-006)
Sales Report Consolidation totals always equal SUM of Transaction Report lines for the same filters
Each data entry completes within 2-3 minutes
Dashboard reflects all transactions up to any selected date
Opening balance auto-populates at month start with no manual intervention

tech_stack.infra: Docker + docker-compose (local), portable to any cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure)

known_integrations: None — fully self-contained single-tenant system in V1
performance_constraints: Sales Report Transaction view may need pagination beyond ~1000 rows (LLD open item #7)
Stock ledger reads back the materialised running balance — dashboard should be sub-second for any single date
engineering.deployment_context: Docker images for backend and frontend, PostgreSQL via docker-compose for local dev, portable to any cloud container runtime
engineering.data_shape: Relational. 6 master tables, 6 transaction tables (3 header + 3 line), 1 stock ledger materialised table. Most operations are header + line-items in a single transaction.

constraints: Transaction dates restricted to today and up to 7 days prior — no future dates
Adjustment Form: only one tile design per entry
Trading Size-Design Master is separate from any manufactured-tile design list
No user authentication in V1 — all users share full access
Grade rows on Inward / Sales forms must derive from Tile Design-Grade Table, not hardcoded
risks: Stock ledger concurrency: simultaneous saves on the same Design+Grade need row-level locking (LLD open item #5)
Dashboard performance: live SUM over inward / sales / adjust per design-grade may need a materialised running-balance table
Month-end carry-forward correctness depends on a deterministic 'last day of previous month' calculation across timezones — DB stored in UTC, dates handled as plain DATE
sprint_1_hypothesis: Sprint 1 delivers the data foundation: all 6 master tables (Supplier, Staff, Dealer, Grade, Trading Size-Design, Design-Grade map) with CRUD admin screens, soft-delete (is_active), seed data per the sample PRD, and PostgreSQL schema + Alembic baseline migration. No transaction forms or stock ledger yet — those land in S2 and S3.
